# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7/v6.9 reg-aegean1/2/3, the Lords of the Aegean, phases 1-3. Generated by gen_aegean_lords.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES id 36: a hook); this line writes
# no monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.2): sync, the fiefs, world steps W1-W2, at most one event, then January.
oe_aeg_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_live } } set_global_variable = oe_aeg_live }
        set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1463.1.1 } set_variable = oe_aeg_off }
        else = {
            oe_aeg_sync = yes
            oe_aeg_fiefs = yes
            oe_aeg_world = yes
            oe_aeg_events = yes
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_aeg_january = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. 1 the second civil war's result, read only (design 3.2 item 1), and recording the month oe_l7_end = 1
# is first seen (phase 3, .8). oe_cw2.20 a puts the fief modifier on Mytilene: the family holds Lesbos (1). The promise
# of oe_cw2.13 and the Palaiologan victory without a fief 9 months later: the promise was broken (2). A fief that
# appears after a 2 still makes it 1.
oe_aeg_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_gat } global_var:oe_aeg_gat ?= 2 } location:mitilene = { oe_aeg_loc_fief = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = 60 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_tie value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_gat } has_global_variable = oe_cw2_gattilusio_promised has_global_variable = oe_cw2_palaiologan_won }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_cw2_seen } } set_variable = oe_aeg_cw2_seen set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_cw2_wait months = 9 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_cw2_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_l7_m } oe_aeg_l7_held = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_l7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. 2 the fiefs (design 3.2 item 2; 六 10): the second civil war's modifier and the captain's fief modifier go

oe_aeg_fiefs = {
    location:mitilene = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:molyvos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:enez = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:thasos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:lemnos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:lemnos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief } }
    location:imbros = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief } }
    location:thasos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_bloc = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_aeg_gat ?= 1 NOT = { oe_aeg_has_fief = yes } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 6 } }
}

# BYZ scope. 3 world steps W1 (the Maona) and W2 (the Fall of Phokaia, design 3.3). No pop-up, no lock.
oe_aeg_world = {
    oe_aeg_lease_end = yes
    location:chios = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_gen = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona } }
    location:foca = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona NOT = { oe_aeg_loc_gen = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_aeg_m >= 122 var:oe_aeg_m <= 1428 location:chios = { owner ?= c:GEN } }
        if = { limit = { oe_aeg_gen_ai = yes } oe_aeg_w1 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_aeg_ws_1 ?= 1 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_1 value = 3 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_aeg_m > 1428 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_ws_1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_1 value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_aeg_ws_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_aeg_ws_2 ?= 2 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_aeg_m >= 1422 var:oe_aeg_m <= 1434 }
            if = { limit = { oe_aeg_w2_can = yes } random = { chance = oe_aeg_w2_ch oe_aeg_w2 = yes } }
            else_if = { limit = { location:foca = { owner ?= c:GEN } oe_aeg_w2_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_2 value = 3 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_aeg_m > 1434 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_ws_2 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_2 value = 2 }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. W1 itself (also the test button aegw1): the modifier on Chios, and on Phokaia while an AI Genoa holds it;
# the first time, the globals oe_aeg_maona (1) and oe_aeg_maona_m (the month).
oe_aeg_w1 = {
    oe_aeg_lease_end = yes
    if = {
        limit = { location:chios = { oe_aeg_loc_gen = yes } }
        location:chios = { if = { limit = { oe_aeg_loc_gen = yes NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_maona years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:foca = { if = { limit = { oe_aeg_loc_gen = yes NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_maona years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_maona } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_maona value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_maona_m value = oe_ml_month_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_1 value = 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope. W2 itself (Fall of Phokaia, 1455.6-1456.6; also the test button aegw2): AI Genoa hands unbesieged foca to
# AI Ottomans, oe_aeg_maona leaves foca, and both receive a 5-year mutual truce.
oe_aeg_w2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_aeg_w2_can = yes }
        location:foca = {
            change_location_owner = c:TUR
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:foca = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_ws_2 value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:GEN country_exists = c:TUR c:GEN = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } }
                c:GEN = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 5 mutual = yes } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. v6.7 fix-g911 (r23 g11: after .1 b and then .1 c the lease modifier stayed on Chios under Genoa, readout
# isles 13). The farming of Chios (.1 b) ends the moment the island is no longer the empire's own land, by any path:
# the cede (job 11), the Maona (W1 and its test button) or anything else (war, a theme, the console: the monthly world
# step, before January). The lease modifier goes (the January rent reads it and the owner, so the rent stops with it)
# and oe_aeg_chios 3 (farmed out) becomes 4 (the farming ended with the island; job 11 then writes its own 1).
oe_aeg_lease_end = {
    location:chios = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona_lease NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } remove_location_modifier = oe_aeg_maona_lease } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_aeg_chios ?= 3 location:chios = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_chios value = 4 } }
}

# BYZ scope. 5 January (design 3.5): the Maona's tribute, the rent of the farmed island and (phase 2) the Gattilusi's
# gift, then the family's loyalty drifts toward its target. The amounts are kept for the readout (oe_aeg_jan_trib,
# oe_aeg_jan_rent, oe_aeg_jan_gift); the gift is reckoned with the loyalty before the drift.
oe_aeg_january = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_jan_trib value = oe_aeg_trib_amt }
    set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_jan_rent value = oe_aeg_rent_amt }
    set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_jan_gift value = oe_aeg_gift_amt }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_jan_trib > 0 } add_gold = oe_aeg_trib_amt }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_jan_rent > 0 } add_gold = oe_aeg_rent_amt }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_jan_gift > 0 } add_gold = oe_aeg_gift_amt }
    if = { limit = { oe_aeg_lord = yes has_variable = oe_aeg_loy } oe_aeg_loy_pull = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. The yearly drift of the family's loyalty: 2 points toward oe_aeg_loy_target, never past it.
oe_aeg_loy_pull = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy < oe_aeg_loy_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy add = 2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy > oe_aeg_loy_target } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = oe_aeg_loy_target } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy > oe_aeg_loy_target }
        change_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy add = -2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy < oe_aeg_loy_target } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = oe_aeg_loy_target } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Change the family's loyalty by $v$, kept within 0-100 (the form of the oath of Omphalion's appanages,
# pmom_pu_oath_add: change, then set back to the bound; the engine's clamp_variable is not used, it has not been seen).
oe_aeg_loy_add = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_loy } } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = 60 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy add = $v$ }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = 100 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_loy < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = 0 } }
}
# Any scope. Every Gattilusi fief goes back to the crown (design 3.6 job 31; phase 3 .9 a calls it via job 91): the
# second civil war's modifier leaves all five places (the land was the empire's all along); the family's state becomes 3.
oe_aeg_take_back = {
    location:mitilene = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:molyvos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:enez = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:thasos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    location:lemnos = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 3 }
}
# Any scope. The earthquake of .5 (vanilla's earthquake events' form, earthquake_events.txt: change_prosperity): Mytilene's
# prosperity falls a little, whatever is chosen.
oe_aeg_quake = { location:mitilene = { change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_penalty } }

# BYZ scope. Pay or gain $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month).
oe_aeg_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_aeg_gain = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = $months$ } }
# Any scope. Genoa's opinion of the empire (the bias $m$; nothing when Genoa is gone).
oe_aeg_opn = { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $m$ target = c:BYZ } } } }
# Any scope. .1 a and b (design 六 4): vanilla's flavor_gen.16 reads gen_has_maona_event on Genoa; without it Genoa
# cannot take Chios by that event. oe_aeg_genclr: 1 it was there and is gone, 2 it was not there.
oe_aeg_clear_genvar = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { has_variable = gen_has_maona_event } }
        c:GEN = { remove_variable = gen_has_maona_event }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_genclr value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_genclr value = 2 } }
}

    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 72 } oe_aeg_job_72 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 81 } oe_aeg_job_81 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 82 } oe_aeg_job_82 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 83 } oe_aeg_job_83 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 91 } oe_aeg_job_91 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 92 } oe_aeg_job_92 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_job ?= 93 } oe_aeg_job_93 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_aeg_job
}
# 11: .1 c, the handover of Chios (and Phokaia, if ours) to Genoa.
oe_aeg_job_11 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_aeg_may_cede = { loc = chios } } location:chios = { change_location_owner = c:GEN } }
    if = { limit = { oe_aeg_may_cede = { loc = foca } } location:foca = { change_location_owner = c:GEN } }
    if = { limit = { location:chios = { owner ?= c:GEN } } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_fail value = 0 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_fail value = 11 } }
    oe_aeg_lease_end = yes
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_chios value = 1 }
}
# 12: .1 a, Chios held at a price.
oe_aeg_job_12 = {
    oe_aeg_pay = { months = 3 }
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_held }
    oe_aeg_clear_genvar = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_chios value = 2 }
}
# 13: .1 b, the revenues of Chios farmed out.
oe_aeg_job_13 = {
    location:chios = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_maona_lease years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    oe_aeg_gain = { months = 2 }
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_lease }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_on } oe_itp_shift = { r = gen n = 1 } }
    oe_aeg_clear_genvar = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_chios value = 3 }
}
# 21: .2 a, the marriage and Lesbos.
oe_aeg_job_21 = {
    location:mitilene = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } } location:molyvos = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_cw2_gattilusio_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_loy value = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_tie value = 1 }
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
}

    oe_aeg_pay = { months = 1 }

oe_aeg_job_23 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_gat value = 5 }
}
# 31: .5 b, every fief taken back.

    oe_aeg_take_back = yes
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_resume }

# 71: .7 a, the marriage.
oe_aeg_job_71 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aeg_tie } } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_tie value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_aeg_tie add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_aeg_tie > 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_aeg_tie value = 4 } }
    oe_aeg_loy_add = { v = 15 }
    oe_aeg_gain = { months = 1 }
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
}
# 72: .7 b, the marriage declined.
oe_aeg_job_72 = {
    oe_aeg_loy_add = { v = -10 }
}
# 81: .8 a, the promised island granted to the captain.
oe_aeg_job_81 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_aeg_cap_free = { loc = lemnos } } location:lemnos = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_aeg_cap_free = { loc = imbros } } location:imbros = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_aeg_cap_free = { loc = thasos } } location:thasos = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_aeg_captain_fief years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_captain }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_cap value = 1 }
}
# 82: .8 b, the promise paid off in gold.
oe_aeg_job_82 = {
    oe_aeg_pay = { months = 3 }
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_cap_pay }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_cap value = 2 }
}

oe_aeg_job_83 = {
    oe_aeg_opn = { m = oe_aeg_b_cap_no }
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_aeg_cap value = 3 }
}

}
